description: Agentic-prefill server settings, after Inferact's PP study: context up to 128K tokens so a long shared prefix fits, the local prefix cache on, a 16384-token step budget, and at most 8192 tokens of one request per step. Inferact used a 32768-token budget, but with it vLLM 0.31 on GLM-5.3 fails in the MoE shared-expert code (AssertionError in shared_experts.py; upstream issue vllm-project/vllm#46857 has no merged fix). Use it with benchmarks/poisson-agentic.tsv (100K shared prefix plus 7.5K-12.5K new tokens).
